stack.frontend: vanilla JS + Papa Parse + HubSpot sortable.js (GitHub Pages)

summary.tests: cargo test 3/3 pass (1 failed before fixes)

bugs.title: GitHub access token printed to logs
bugs.current_behavior: info!("Parsed arguments: {:?}", args) Debug-prints the token on every run.
bugs.expected_behavior: Token must never appear in logs.

bugs.title: Reflected DOM XSS via ?lang= parameter
bugs.current_behavior: URL parameter interpolated into languageContentDiv.innerHTML.
bugs.expected_behavior: Untrusted input must be inserted as text, not HTML.

bugs.title: Token exposed via shell command substitution
bugs.current_behavior: shell=True command embeds $(cat access_token.txt); token visible in child argv (ps).
bugs.expected_behavior: Pass secret via environment; no shell.
bugs.fix: argv list + GITHUB_TOKEN env var (supported by the Rust CLI).

bugs.title: Page initialization ran twice
bugs.current_behavior: Nav links + CSV loads existed at top level AND in DOMContentLoaded -> duplicate links/sections, 2x requests, premature Sortable.init.
bugs.expected_behavior: Single initialization path.
bugs.root_cause: Duplicated block left at file end (likely a merge artifact).
bugs.fix: Deleted duplicated top-level block and dead counter variable.

bugs.title: Duplicate 'Size' column in all processed CSVs
bugs.current_behavior: Every processed CSV ended with a second 'Size' column; README rendered 'Size.1'.
bugs.expected_behavior: Exactly one 'Size' column where 'Size (KB)' used to be.
bugs.root_cause: new_columns built from column list taken AFTER df['Size'] was appended, so 'Size' appeared twice.
bugs.fix: df.insert() at Size (KB) index + drop(); regenerated all data + README.
bugs.verification: run_post_processing; header asserts; no 'Size.1' in README

bugs.title: test_parse_languages_with_default_list failing
bugs.current_behavior: assert_eq!(display_name, "C#") failed: list contained ("CSharp","CSharp").
bugs.expected_behavior: Display names match site semantics (C#, C++, Vim script).

bugs.title: Prolog missing from default language list
bugs.current_behavior: 34 defaults vs 35 in main.py/main.js; standalone runs skipped Prolog.
bugs.expected_behavior: All 35 languages fetched by default.
bugs.root_cause: List not updated when Prolog was added elsewhere.

bugs.title: README TOC anchors broken
bugs.current_behavior: Links like #C++, #Vim-script, #Objective-C never matched GitHub's slugified heading ids.
bugs.expected_behavior: Anchors use GitHub slug rules (lowercase, punctuation stripped, dedup -1/-2).
bugs.root_cause: Raw display text used as fragment.

bugs.title: deploy/schedule targets reference removed Prefect flow
bugs.current_behavior: prefect deployment build main.py:run_kstars_flow -> would fail; prefect not in requirements.txt.
bugs.expected_behavior: Targets either work or are removed.
bugs.fix: Removed targets; 'run' now depends on build-crate.

bugs.title: Infinite retry on any failure
bugs.current_behavior: while True: retries every 5 min forever -> cron hangs on deterministic errors.
bugs.expected_behavior: Bounded retries, then fail the job.

bugs.title: No Papa.parse error callback
bugs.current_behavior: A failed CSV fetch dropped the section and blocked Sortable.init() forever (counter never reached languages.length).
bugs.expected_behavior: Error surfaces to user; init still completes.
bugs.root_cause: Missing error handler + counter only incremented on success.
bugs.fix: Added error callback that renders a message and completes the counter.

bugs.title: kstars binary not on PATH
bugs.current_behavior: make run invoked bare 'kstars' -> FileNotFoundError unless manually installed.
bugs.expected_behavior: Pipeline finds the locally built binary.
bugs.root_cause: No install step; no fallback path.
bugs.fix: find_kstars_binary() falls back to target/release/kstars; run depends on build-crate.
bugs.verification: code review; binary exists at target/release/kstars

bugs.title: CSV filename derived from display name
bugs.current_behavior: -l CPP:C++ would write C++.csv, not the site's CPP.csv.
bugs.expected_behavior: Filenames always come from the API name.

bugs.title: Missing Vim-script display name
bugs.current_behavior: Title rendered 'kstars Vim-script' instead of 'Vim script'.
bugs.expected_behavior: Consistent display names across pages.

bugs.title: Panic on malformed token
bugs.current_behavior: HeaderValue::from_str(...).expect() -> crash on non-ASCII control chars.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return a contextual error.

bugs.title: Unencoded language in URLs
bugs.current_behavior: Language interpolated into API URL and CSV path without encoding.
bugs.expected_behavior: Percent-encode user-controlled path/query parts.
bugs.fix: reqwest .query() in Rust; encodeURIComponent in JS.

bugs.title: target=_blank without rel=noopener
bugs.current_behavior: window.open and links opened with implicit window.opener access.
bugs.expected_behavior: noopener on all _blank navigations.
bugs.fix: rel='noopener noreferrer' on links; 'noopener' in window.open.

bugs.title: truncateStringAtWord crashes on non-strings
bugs.current_behavior: Number-like cells -> str.slice TypeError.
bugs.expected_behavior: Tolerate any cell type.
bugs.fix: Coerce via String(str) after null check.

bugs.title: Element-wise date parsing crashed cron on bad values
bugs.current_behavior: df[col].apply(pd.to_datetime) raised on a single unparseable value, aborting the whole job.
bugs.expected_behavior: Vectorized parsing; bad values -> empty cell + warning.
bugs.root_cause: apply(pd.to_datetime) per element, no error handling.

bugs.title: 70 Syncthing sync-conflict files committed
bugs.current_behavior: *.sync-conflict-*.csv tracked and deployed to Pages.
bugs.expected_behavior: Conflict artifacts never committed.

documented_not_fixed: Dead hover CSS rules for .language-nav (opacity set, max-height never opens).
Page cache has no TTL; stale pages only refreshed after fully successful runs.
No CI pipeline, no JS linter/formatter, no CSP meta tag.
Local access_token.txt (gitignored) should be rotated and have minimal scopes.
